title: SUMMER CAMP 2026
subtitle: An action-packed summer experience combining martial arts, fitness, and fun!
about_text:
Our Martial Arts Summer Camp is the perfect way for kids to stay active, learn new skills, and make lasting friendships during the summer months. Each week-long session combines Taekwondo training with fitness activities, team-building exercises, and character development lessons.

Campers will enjoy a structured daily schedule that includes warm-up exercises, Taekwondo instruction, games, and cool-down activities. All experience levels are welcome — from complete beginners to advanced students.
